low.title: Half-Day Vukovar Mixed Highlights on a Low Budget
low.summary: A compact, budget-friendly combination of history, riverside nature, local culture, and affordable food.

schedule.title: Danube Riverside Warm-Up Walk
schedule.description: Start with calm nature, river views, and a few public artworks along the promenade.

schedule.title: Historic Town Center Walk
schedule.description: See restored buildings, memorial plaques, and traces of Vukovar’s heritage.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Try simple Slavonian dishes — stews, grilled options, soups.

schedule.title: Short Art & Nature Blend
schedule.description: Finish with a peaceful walk through scenic areas and small artistic corners around the promenade.

medium.title: Balanced Half-Day Mixed Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable half-day blending local history, nature, and art with a well-priced lunch.

schedule.title: Riverside + Sculpture Start
schedule.description: Walk along the Danube and explore small artistic details.

schedule.title: Heritage Streets
schedule.description: See Vukovar’s restored façades and historically important areas.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: A hearty traditional meal at a mid-range restaurant.

schedule.title: Nature + Old Town Blend
schedule.description: Wrap up with a short walk through green areas and charming streets.

high.title: High-End Mixed Tour
high.summary: A refined blend of Vukovar’s natural, historical, and artistic highlights paired with high-quality local dining.

schedule.title: Premium Riverside Start
schedule.description: Walk through the most scenic parts of the promenade with elegant views.

schedule.title: Curated Heritage Corners
schedule.description: Visit restored historical spots with strong architectural character.

schedule.title: High-Quality Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy refined local dishes prepared with excellent ingredients.

schedule.title: Elegant Nature + Art Finish
schedule.description: A short walk through the calmest green areas with artistic details.

comfortable.title: Luxury Mixed Half-Day Experience
comfortable.summary: A polished half-day showcasing Vukovar’s finest nature, heritage, and artistic spots with luxury dining.

schedule.title: Luxury Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Start with the most elegant riverside section for premium scenery.

schedule.title: Exclusive Heritage Corners
schedule.description: See the most refined historical streets and restored façades.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Local Lunch
schedule.description: Premium traditional dishes with exceptional presentation.

schedule.title: Premium Nature + Art Wrap-Up
schedule.description: End with a refined blend of greenery and artistic installations.
